verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships a documented public REST API with a published OpenAPI spec and bearer-token auth. However, that API is explicitly scoped to syncs, models, sources and destinations, while much of the product (audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning agents) is described as a no-code UI. The MCP server and Git Sync extend programmatic reach to audiences and journeys, but nothing documents full UI parity. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of audiences, journeys, AI Decisioning agents, identity resolution and workspace/permission settings; an explicit API–UI parity statement; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.
Configure syncs in the app or take control via API.
Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
